milestones.label: Deligne-Mumford: irreducibility of the moduli of curves via stable curves
milestones.work: Deligne, P.; Mumford, D., The irreducibility of the space of curves of given genus, Publ. Math. IHES 36, 1969, 75-109
milestones.description: Mumford's quotient construction is used to build the moduli space of stable curves as a quotient of a Hilbert-scheme open set, applied to the irreducibility problem.

evidence.claim: Deligne and Mumford's 1969 paper proves irreducibility of the moduli of curves; the moduli space is a quotient of a Hilbert-scheme subset by PGL, and the GIT article states that quotients as moduli were the motivation of Mumford's theory
evidence.source: Wikipedia, Moduli of algebraic curves and Geometric invariant theory (raw wikitext)

evidence.claim: Bibliographic record: 'The irreducibility of the space of curves of given genus', Publ. Math. IHES 36 (1969) pp. 75-109

milestones.note: Year and paper supported. That it is the first purposeful GIT application (versus earlier moduli uses by Mumford himself in 1965-1968) is not verified by a history source, and the history source supports GIT use only indirectly. Do not promote without a further check.
